title: System-dynamics model of adoption, capacity, and value
purpose: Explores feedback among training, trust, adoption, workforce capacity, workload, benefit realization, and support burden over time.
input: `Parameters` sheet with initial stocks, rates, feedback strengths, simulation horizon, and time step.
outputs: Time-series stocks and flows, adoption/capacity/value trajectories, scenario summary, and feedback visualization.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
